name: Scarlett's Sorrows
source:
On a brisk autumn day, you meet Scarlett, a reclusive and beautiful woman. Although you become fast friends, Scarlett seems to want more – and might not take rejection so well. Can you find the root of Scarlett’s insecurities and help her make peace with herself?

[From [url=https://wingberry.itch.io/scarletts-sorrows]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在一个秋高气爽的日子里，你遇到了斯嘉丽，一个隐居的美丽女人。虽然你们很快成为了朋友，但斯嘉丽似乎想要更多——而且可能不太能接受拒绝。你能找到斯嘉丽不安全感的根源并帮助她与自己和解吗？

[来自[url=https://wingberry.itch.io/scarletts-sorrows]itch.io[/url]]
